desc: 一对机械情侣表，星期日历双显与透底，钢带皮带可选，主打礼赠
leaf: 精钢表带自动机械星期日历情侣对表
name: 情侣机械对表钢带礼赠款

shots.intent: 亮底成对摆放让买家一秒读懂这是一对情侣表，抢搜索点击并立住礼盒属性。
深色礼赠面板加花瓣与主张文案，把核心利益与送礼理由压缩成一秒可读。
shots.textZone: top centred band: one headline plus two short proof labels above a hairline rule

shots.intent: 只拍袖口与手腕让通勤与商务人群自我代入，避开可识别面孔风险。
俯视双人手腕同框把对表关系视觉化，让送礼对象一眼可见。
等大同光的双栏对照交代两种带型质感差异，替买家完成选带决策。
shots.textZone: one short label above each panel plus a hairline divider between them

shots.intent: 微距交代刻度印刷、指针与星期日历双显窗口，用装配质量替代口号。
shots.textZone: right grey panel: one label plus one short sub-label

shots.intent: 后侧 45 度透视底盖特写摆陀与轮系，用可见结构证明机械构造而非口头宣称。
正侧面微距交代表冠滚花、壳厚与链节倒角，回答做工与佩戴手感疑问。
shots.textZone: right margin: one label plus one short sub-label

shots.intent: 亮底规格屏用引线标注壳径壳厚带宽与把冠档位，数值留空待真实参数合成。
shots.textZone: hairline dimension leader lines around case and strap, a three-step crown diagram, four label fields and a top title band, all copy as placeholders

shots.intent: 两行三列把盘面色壳色与两种带型一次排齐，让买家自行选配成对。
shots.textZone: top band: one headline plus six short option labels under the cells

shots.intent: 低角度水带加日常场景线性图标承接防水卖点，真实等级数值一律留空。
shots.textZone: lower band: one short rating label plus four square-framed thin-line scenario icons with short labels

shots.intent: 回到深色礼赠语境用开盖双表与按钮位收口，承接成对下单动作。
shots.textZone: upper band: one headline; lower right: one rounded button

style.backgroundSystem: bright-dominant set: seamless paper-bright sweep #FFFFFF and cool grey matte laminate #EDEFF2 for packshot, spec and variant screens, with one single deep charcoal velvet gift field #17181C reserved for the opening benefit screen and the closing gift screen
style.direction: premium bright-tone couple watch gift commerce
style.iconSystem: minimal thin-line outline icons inside small square frames at 1.2px stroke in #A8232E, single-check markers only, no filled pictograms, no badge shields
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light from the upper left with a fill card on the shadow side, controlled narrow specular streaks along polished steel edges, low-contrast shadows, always a true contact shadow grounding each piece; one crisp rim light on the low-angle screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium bright-tone couple watch gift commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper-bright background #FFFFFF, cool neutral grey #EDEFF2, deep charcoal gift field #17181C, and one deep crimson accent #A8232E; cool neutral tone; one font family only, modern geometric sans-serif with a clean Chinese sans for callouts; background system of seamless paper-bright sweeps and cool grey matte laminate with a single deep charcoal velvet gift field; bright soft high-key key light from the upper left with fill card, controlled narrow specular streaks on polished steel, low-contrast shadows and a true contact shadow under every piece; minimal thin-line square-framed outline icons in #A8232E with hairline rules; stable pair staging with the larger case behind-left and the smaller case forward-right at a consistent 3/4 angle, dials legible, strap colours hex-pinned, macro reserved for dial, day-date aperture, crown, links and exhibition caseback, no human face in frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm vintage grade, no sparkle artifacts, no duplicated watch parts.
noDrift: no warm vintage or retro grade
no duplicated or missing watch parts
no visible faces or brand wordmarks
style.presentationRules: the pair is always staged together at a consistent 3/4 angle with the larger case behind-left and the smaller case forward-right; dials squared to camera and legible; brushed-and-polished case finish kept identical across shots; strap option colours hex-pinned; macro limited to dial face and day-date aperture, crown, bracelet links and exhibition caseback; no human face ever in frame, wrists cropped at the cuff or forearm
style.surfaceSystem: seamless paper-bright sweep #FFFFFF, cool grey matte laminate #E7E9EC, soft crumpled fabric #F2F3F5 for wrist screens, deep charcoal velvet #17181C only on the two gift screens; no wood grain, no marble, no coloured tint cards
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Latin plus one clean Chinese sans for callouts, hairline rules and thin boxed label frames, headline 28-40pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, no serif or handwritten faces
